mapper.select: SELECT f.*, t.name as teacher_name, b.title as book_title FROM fine f LEFT JOIN teacher t ON f.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN borrow_record br ON f.borrow_id = br.id LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id WHERE f.id = #{id}

SELECT f.*, t.name as teacher_name, b.title as book_title FROM fine f LEFT JOIN teacher t ON f.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN borrow_record br ON f.borrow_id = br.id LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id
AND t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{teacherName}, '%')
AND f.status = #{status}
ORDER BY f.fine_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fine (teacher_id, borrow_id, amount, fine_date, due_days, status, remark) VALUES (#{teacherId}, #{borrowId}, #{amount}, #{fineDate}, #{dueDays}, 0, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE fine SET status = #{status}, pay_date = #{payDate} WHERE id = #{id}
